time_and_price_semantics.mark_index: RAW_EPOCH_MS; open_us=timestamp_ms*1000; exclusive close_us=(close_time_ms+1)*1000. Closed-bar availability proxy only; placeholder ignore columns are not traded volume.
time_and_price_semantics.funding: calc_time_ms and reported interval hours preserved, including raw jitter. No exact charge/publication certification; rate unit UNCONFIRMED; no pre-event visibility certification.
time_and_price_semantics.endpoint: open<score end exclusive; final completed candle may close exactly at March1. Do not read bars opened March1 or later; filter day decisions before score end.
time_and_price_semantics.warmup: Only completed UTC daily bars available at decision. First score is fresh flat; warmup is not an account return.
time_and_price_semantics.header_correction: Use append-only old122_header_correction: all actual mark/index headers present; original synopsis bytes retained.
